position_overview:
At Job Duck , we are looking for a Legal Executive Assistant with a strong focus on office administration and operational support, complemented by light legal assistance. This role ensures that daily workflows run seamlessly, deadlines are consistently met, and administrative processes are handled with precision.

The right candidate will thrive in a structured environment, taking ownership of recurring processes while proactively identifying and resolving issues. Success in this position comes from being highly organized, dependable, and responsive, with a natural ability to follow through on tasks without constant supervision. If you are detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to contribute to a collaborative team, this opportunity offers a rewarding path to make a daily impact.

• Monthly Compensation: 1060 USD to 1150 USD
key_responsibilities:
include, but are not limited to:

Manage and organize daily office workflows

Maintain calendars, reminders, and task tracking systems

Ensure deadlines are met for payroll inputs and internal processes

Support event planning and coordination

Provide basic legal assistance where required

Support billing processes and documentation

Monitor and manage voicemails, ensuring timely assignment and issue identification

Assist with billing-related administrative tasks

Follow up consistently on assigned tasks without prompting

Take ownership of recurring processes such as payroll reminders and approvals

Attend and actively participate in scheduled meetings

Respond promptly to emails and internal communications
qualifications:
•2-3 years of experience working as an Executive Assistant

•Legal background is highly appreciated

•Billing knowledge is a plus

•Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint)

•Experience with case management or legal software (Smokeball) 

•Familiarity with communication platforms such as Zoom 

•Comfortable using document tools such as Adobe

Required Skills

•Detail-oriented 

•Strong organizational skills 

•Effective written and verbal communication 

•Ability to manage and prioritize tasks independently 

•High level of accuracy and consistency 

•Proactive and self-motivated work style 

•Dependable and accountable 

•Comfortable with routine processes 

Work Shift:
9:00 AM - 6:00 PM [PST][PDT] (United States of America)
Languages:
English, Spanish
